en.title: Netflix's Longest-Running Shows: Gabby's Dollhouse Nears 100 Episodes
en.summary: While Netflix is known for quick cancellations, a select few scripted originals have defied the odds. The preschool hit **Gabby's Dollhouse** is now on the cusp of a major milestone no adult drama has reached.
en.body:
## A Marathon, Not a Sprint

Netflix's reputation for a swift axe has long been a source of fan anxiety, with the dreaded "two seasons and canceled" meme a constant reminder. Yet, scattered like hidden gems across its vast library are a handful of scripted originals that have achieved remarkable staying power. Back in 2022, **Grace and Frankie** stood tall as the longest-running drama by episode count, having just wrapped its impressive seven-season run. Since then, the landscape has shifted considerably. **Big Mouth** concluded its record eighth season, while fan favorites like **Elite**, **The Crown**, and **The Upshaws** have also signed off. Meanwhile, **Virgin River** is set to tie the all-time record with a ninth season renewal.

However, one significant benchmark remains elusive for adult-oriented programming: the coveted 100-episode mark, a number that once signified syndication gold on traditional television. As of November 2026, no scripted adult Netflix original has hit this milestone. The definition of "original" is key here; this count excludes shows that began elsewhere before migrating to Netflix, such as **Lucifer** or **Cobra Kai**, focusing solely on series that premiered on the platform. This distinction is crucial when examining the true longevity of Netflix's in-house productions.

## The Preschool Powerhouse

While adult dramas grapple with reaching the century mark, a surprising contender from the preschool demographic is not only in contention but is poised to be the first scripted Netflix original to achieve it. DreamWorks’ live-action/animated hit, **Gabby's Dollhouse**, has quietly become a titan of longevity. Though its seasons are typically concise, ranging from five to eight episodes, they arrive with remarkable frequency. By September 2026, the show had already amassed 90 episodes, with creators confirming in 2024 that they had enough content banked to sustain it through 2027. This strategic planning means **Gabby's Dollhouse** is on track to surpass 100 episodes by next year, a feat that underscores the different viewing habits and production models for children's programming versus adult series.

## What's Next for Binge-Watchers

As **Gabby's Dollhouse** marches toward its 100th episode, the narrative around Netflix's longest-running shows continues to evolve. **Virgin River** is on a clear path to matching **Grace and Frankie**'s episode total, demonstrating that consistent storytelling can still win the long game on the streaming giant. The success of these longer-running series offers a beacon of hope for fans invested in serialized narratives, proving that not every beloved show is destined for an early demise. The journey to 100 episodes is a testament to sustained creative vision and audience engagement.

Netflix has long had a reputation for cutting shows short, but scattered throughout its library are a handful of originals that have racked up a genuinely impressive number of episodes. When we first ran this list back in 2022, Grace and Frankie had just wrapped up and House of Cards was the longest-running drama by episodes. A lot has changed since then. Big Mouth signed off with a record eighth season, Elite, The Crown, and The Upshaws all wrapped up, and Virgin River has now been renewed for a ninth season that’ll see it tie the all-time record. Still, one milestone remains out of reach: no scripted Netflix original for adults has hit 100 episodes, a number that once signaled syndication riches on traditional TV. As you’ll see further down, though, a preschool show is now closer than anyone. How we counted: Episode totals are as of November 2026 and cover Netflix original series that premiered on Netflix. We’ve left out unscripted shows and series that began life on another network before moving to Netflix, such as Lucifer and Cobra Kai. Kids & family titles get their own section at the bottom. Picture Credit: What’s on Netflix  1. Grace and Frankie Seasons: 7 Episodes: 94 Years: 2015–2022 Marta Kauffman and Howard J. Morris’s comedy remains the Netflix original with the most episodes, four years after its finale. Starring Jane Fonda and Lily Tomlin as two women whose husbands leave them for each other, the show ran for seven years thanks in part to a supersized final season that was split into two batches ( the first of which dropped early ) after COVID-19 delayed production. Its record isn’t safe forever, though. Virgin River is on course to match it (more on that below). 2. Orange Is the New Black Seasons: 7 Episodes: 91 Years: 2013–2019 Picture Credit: Netflix One of Netflix’s founding originals, Orange Is the New Black held the episode record for several years before Grace and Frankie overtook it. Its legacy on the service is huge: back in July 2019, Netflix said 105 million users had watched the show. There’s long been talk of a follow-up set in the same world, so we wouldn’t rule out Litchfield returning in some form one day. Here’s what we know about a potential spin-off . 3. Big Mouth Seasons: 8 Episodes: 81 Years: 2017–2025 When we last updated this list, Big Mouth had just 51 episodes, with more on the way. Nick Kroll’s raunchy adult-animated comedy kept going all the way to an eighth and final season in May 2025 , finishing with 81 episodes. At the time, Netflix called it the longest-running scripted series in its history by seasons (excluding kids & family). That title is now heading to Virgin River. 4.
